summary: Russian forces launched massed drone attacks on Kropyvnytskyi and Kropyvnytskyi region, causing massive fires at industrial and infrastructure sites. Multiple Gern-5 missiles struck Shepetivka and surrounding areas. Ukrainian forces conducted precision strikes on Russian airfields and logistics. Starlink restrictions disrupted Ukrainian operations. Russian drone corridors extended across multiple regions.

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces intensified missile and drone strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions, employing Gern-5 missiles and massed attack drones to target urban centers, infrastructure, and energy facilities. Ukrainian air defenses engaged multiple incoming threats while Ukrainian forces conducted precision strikes on Russian airfields and logistics. Starlink restrictions by SpaceX disrupted Ukrainian operational communications, creating additional vulnerability. Russian drone corridors now extend from Kherson through Myklyniv to Kropyvnytskyi, threatening southern and central regions simultaneously. Ukrainian forces face increasing pressure on multiple fronts as Russian kinetic and electronic warfare capabilities expand.
sections.regional_response: International allies continue military and humanitarian support for Ukraine while condemning Russian intensified strikes. NATO monitoring of Russian drone corridors and missile launches. European states reviewing air defense capabilities amid expanded Russian strike ranges. SpaceX Starlink restrictions prompting Ukraine to seek alternative communications. Regional neighbors on alert for spillover effects. Diplomatic channels active regarding weapons restrictions and support sustainability.
